purpose: Test whether natural historical-A update regressions persist after removing the original no-op control shortcut that repeated the initial answer near the question. This is a native diagnostic before any new semantic update architecture, not a claim that previous B regressions were invalid.

gate.data_registration: Freeze executable data, exact tokenizer identities, every record/value boundary, source snapshots and evaluation order before any new model inference. Preserve all old protocols and sources.

construction.entity_namespace: E700 through E899; random.Random(base_seed) shuffles once. First three names are A,B,C at every load and value condition.
construction.values_rng: random.Random(base_seed + 410009).sample(range(100,1000),4*162); contiguous162-value slice per sibling. Reuse record-index values at both loads. All sampled values distinct.
construction.record_0: SET A values[0], the only occurrence of the historical target numeric value anywhere in either world.
construction.record_1: SET B values[1]. B is retained as a common account, not an additional query in this focused history test.
construction.record_3: SET A values[3]. This common intermediate/current value differs from initial_A in every case.
construction.records_4_through_159: 156 SET records on entities[3:active_accounts], never A,B,C. Concatenate independently shuffled cycles using random.Random(base_seed+310003+active_accounts), then truncate. Every active account appears. Record i uses values[i].
construction.record_160: SET A values[3] in hold_middle; SET A values[160] in update_new. Both values differ from values[0]. Only the three registered value-digit tokens may differ between worlds.
construction.record_161: SET C values[161] in BOTH worlds, retaining the legitimate other-account current-value update guard.

queries.target_initial: What was the initial balance of account A? Truth is values[0] in both worlds.
queries.target_current: What is the current balance of account A? Truth is values[3] or values[160], graded against its own world.
queries.other_current: What is the current balance of account C? Truth is values[161] in both worlds.

construction.prompt: Use the unchanged existing native account-ledger instructions, renderer and full-prefill text-only IT runtime. A,B,C in query descriptions are replaced with actual account IDs. No extra explanation, oracle address or candidate restriction.
construction.interpretation: The initial-A fact has identical literal occurrence count, token age, location and complete common prefix in both final worlds. Both final current-A values differ from the initial answer, eliminating the former latest-value shortcut. The repeated middle value changes by design; a remaining functional regression still does not isolate recurrent-state damage from attention/representation effects.

data_audits: Recompute all truths with the executable SET interpreter; the initial answer appears numerically in exactly one record, at record0, in every source world.
Exactly160 common records and2 tail records; exactly the registered live-account load and all prescribed identities/positions.
Every sibling has four distinct answers for each role/world, and identical question IDs, operation/target schedule and boundaries.

For a fixed case/role, hold_middle and update_new have equal prompt lengths and identical tokens except the three isolated digits at record160. All loads have equal length and query suffix, fixed A/B/C positions, common initial/middle/new-A/new-C values and no A/B/C distractor writes.
The frozen registry retains all64pairs and384own-world questions, with no initially-correct or error-only filtering. Reject failed token/length/record audits without dropping examples.
The new seed ranges were absent from current configs/scripts/tests before registration. Do not consume the reserved70000-series confirmation cohort.

evaluation.generation: Unrestricted greedy generation, maximum12 new tokens, stop at newline/EOS; complete outputs, exact-answer grading, fixed three-digit gold NLL separately.
evaluation.prefix_processing: Full prefill for every query; compare only natural full-prefill worlds. No mixed caches, oracle slicing, adapters, checkpoint selection or training.
evaluation.operational_smoke: First lexicographic case/value per cohort/load:4pairs,8prefix worlds and24questions. Safety/coverage gate only; no accuracy threshold. Independent smoke audit before complete384-query evaluation.
evaluation.safety: Same existing base environment and local native model. Full loaded-state hashes before/after, no gradients/adapters, actual six-layer full-prefill/cached historical access on min/max pair identities per cohort/load, and exact duplicate native readout replay on the same prescribed historical queries. Full coverage16history observations/replays; smoke8.
evaluation.reporting: Both cohorts and both loads, all role/world accuracies and NLL, each of64paired transitions, current-A/current-C/joint success, every base stream and all four values. Report correct-to-incorrect transitions descriptively with all baseline failures/denominators visible; do not treat sibling readouts as independent samples.
evaluation.primary_signal: At128accounts in EACH cohort, historical-A correct hold_middle -> incorrect update_new transitions occur in at least two distinct base streams, with current_A and current_C correct in both worlds for those qualified transitions. Also report all unqualified transitions separately. This is a descriptive replication gate, not a statistical significance claim.
evaluation.secondary_signal: 32-account outcomes and NLL shifts are secondary; they cannot replace a failed128-account primary.
evaluation.floor_control: If hold_middle initial-A accuracy is4/16or below in a cohort/load, flag limited baseline competence and avoid interpreting absent regressions as proof of preserved memory.
evaluation.if_primary_absent: Record that original history errors do not yet supply clean evidence for the proposed semantic update co-design. Distinguish a removed recency shortcut, low historical retrieval competence and genuine absence of the registered functional effect. Do not automatically train adapters, expand thresholds or scale models.
evaluation.if_primary_present: Register a subsequent event/path mechanism diagnosis with current-value commit guards before any new architecture. A remaining differential error alone does not establish shared-interface necessity.

scope: This focused SET-only check supplements earlier B/order/COPY/history controls and the complete fixed-checkpoint panel. It neither replaces them nor guarantees that the broad semantic-dependency architecture is impossible.
implementation_status: Protocol only. New data provider, frozen dataset, runner, auditor and model inference have not started.
